title: Volume Administration Rates for Larger Microsoft 365 Subscriptions
content:
Larger Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscriptions take a volume administration rate. It is set by the licenses the administration fee counts, which are the licenses the subscription's quantity changes have added less those they have removed, as they stand when the fee posts.

| Licenses counted | Effect on the plan's administration fee per license |
|---|---|
| 100 or more | multiplied by 80 percent |
| 25 to 99 | multiplied by 90 percent |
| fewer than 25 | no volume rate |

**Edges of the bands.** 24 licenses take no volume rate, and 25 take 90 percent. 99 licenses take 90 percent, and 100 take 80 percent.

**Scope of the count.** The count is the licenses on this one subscription. Licenses on the tenant's other subscriptions are not added in.

## Hypothetical illustration

On a hypothetical plan fee of 2.00 USD per license:

- 120 licenses counted give a rate of 1.60 per license;
- 40 licenses give 1.80;
- 20 licenses keep the plan's 2.00.
